description.value: GlycoVaxyn offers a solution to produce therapeutic glycoproteins faster and at lower costs. The company will use its technology platform to develop novel conjugated vaccines which cannot be produced by traditional methods.

viagogo is an online ticket exchange that allows people to buy and sell live event tickets in a safe and guaranteed environment. viagogo facilitates the exchange between someone who wants to sell and someone who wants to buy live event tickets. By managing payment and delivery viagogo guarantee that buyers will receive their tickets and sellers will receive payment.

Calico provides product configuration solutions used in industries such as communications, healthcare and high-tech manufacturing, where configurations for equipment and services are often complex. IPO on Nasdaq in October 1999. Acquired by PeopleSoft in December 2001.
